# Manichaeism; ANTIQVITAS master plan §9; IRAN-MANI; recipient=PAR
antq_m10_third.3006 = {
	type = country_event
	title = antq_m10_third.3006.title
	desc = antq_m10_third.3006.desc
	outcome = neutral
	fire_only_once = yes
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event/antq_manichaeism_foundation.dds"
	dynamic_historical_event = {
		tag = XAH
		from = 240.1.1
		to = 275.1.1
		monthly_chance = 100
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10_third.3006.a
		historical_option = yes
		set_variable = antq_m10_manichaeism_foundation_chronicle_path
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = { factor = 1.24 stability >= 20 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.84 at_war = yes }
		}
		religion:antq_manichaeism = {
			enable_religion = yes
			create_holy_site = { name = antq_manichaean_babylonia_mission type = pilgrimage_city importance = 5 location = location:baghdad religions = { religion:antq_manichaeism } }
		}
		# IRAN-MANI: seed a bounded community without converting the Iranian state.
		capital = {
			every_pop = {
				limit = { religion = religion:antq_arsacid_zoroastrianism }
				split_pop = { fraction = 0.02 religion = religion:antq_manichaeism }
			}
		}
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		# Learned practice shapes the response; it never gates the current.
		if = {
			limit = { has_advance = antq_crisis_communities }
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10_third.3006.b
		set_variable = antq_m10_manichaeism_foundation_compact_path
		add_gold = -18
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = { factor = 1.6 stability < 0 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.6 gold < 30 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10_third.3006.c
		set_variable = antq_m10_manichaeism_foundation_command_path

		}

		add_manpower = { value = root.monthly_manpower multiply = -7 }
		add_gold = { value = root.monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -5 }
		# JRA-CYP-2015/2021: Tunis is the reviewed Carthage location proxy.

			spawn_disease = {
				disease = disease:smallpox
				value = 0.30
			}
			province = { change_province_food_percentage = -0.15 }
		}

		add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = { factor = 1.75 at_war = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 0.25 monthly_manpower < 1 }
		}
	}
}
